observations: Current main BLOGPOST_ENTITY.clay still routes pipeline_build_prompt directly into inference_generate using profile.inference and prompt.system/user.
MINI_ENTITY_COGNITIVE_FABRIC_ADMISSION/v1 is explicitly a pre-inference candidate/provenance admission boundary and grants no canonical truth/effect authority.

The canonical UNIFIED_COGNITIVE_FABRIC_RUNTIME_RECEIPT/v1 validator requires post-inference fields including inference.executed, candidate_result_digest, authority.validation_decision, authority.canonical_write_committed, authority.effect_committed and execution.terminal_result_digest.
Therefore the final canonical UCF runtime receipt cannot truthfully be completed before the deterministic gate and commit/no-commit outcome are known.

identity_law.pre_inference_receipt: MINI_ENTITY_COGNITIVE_FABRIC_ADMISSION/v1 or an explicitly versioned equivalent; candidate/provenance only
identity_law.final_runtime_receipt: UNIFIED_COGNITIVE_FABRIC_RUNTIME_RECEIPT/v1; emitted only after terminal gate/commit state exists

donor_adjudication.one_phase_admit_lanes: RETAIN_AS_PRE_ADMISSION_DONOR_ONLY; they do not by themselves emit the final post-turn UCF-v1 receipt
donor_adjudication.prepare_finalize_before_gate_lane_1207: RETAIN_PARTIAL_DONOR_ONLY; PREPARE insight is useful, but FINALIZE-before-GATE/COMMIT is too early for canonical UCF-v1 authority fields
donor_adjudication.post_turn_binding_lane_1216: RETAIN_AS_POST_TURN_DONOR; it correctly recognizes canonical_write_committed makes the final UCF receipt post-commit evidence
donor_adjudication.reference_runtime_lanes_1210_1227: RETAIN_RUNTIME_DONORS_ONLY; fuse mechanisms fresh on current main rather than create a second runtime

next_implementation_gate: Fresh-current single integration lane: one MiniUnifiedDB-resident versioned cognition-object binding store -> one pre-inference Zero workspace capsule/InferencePacket admission -> inference -> existing deterministic gate/CAS commit -> canonical final UCF-v1 receipt -> post-turn binding. Missing/stale/unbound cognition objects must block or typed-abstain before inference.
